scope: One circular set of four genuinely overlapping refinements; asymmetrical set cancelled
districtDesign:
CITY DISTRICTS: retain recognizable academies: red Phoenix northwest, violet Hydra northeast, blue/cyan Gryffin southwest, gold Dragon southeast. The northern court/residential quarter has refined pale masonry, blue/slate roofs, gardens and larger plots. Commercial streets have varied small gables, modest colorful awnings and dense market lanes. Western/southern artisan blocks use warm brick, tiled workshop roofs, little work yards and restrained chimney smoke. Ordinary residential wards have simpler closely fitted roofs and shared courtyards. Make these visible variations within one medieval magical city, not separate unrelated cities or oversized individual buildings.
GREYFIELD: the dense settlement just OUTSIDE the SOUTHWEST/SOUTH CITY WALL is a slum. Show small cramped irregular timber/plaster homes, patched shingle or tarred roofs, haphazard lean-tos, muddy narrow alleys, limited trees and no landscaped villa plots. Keep its tiny regional scale and human dignity; it is not a field of huge theatrical huts. Farther rural villages such as Brookmeadow/Pebbletown and the coastal town are NOT slums: small maintained roofs, fences, kitchen gardens and more space. Do not turn all outside settlements into poverty.
SCALE: ordinary rural houses have the same footprint as ordinary city roofs, or smaller when distant. Improve roof construction, wall courses, vegetation and shore detail without enlarging the objects. The source shows a broad region. Keep sparse mountains and substantial empty woods; no renewed forty-landmark list, giant caves, oversized cabins, stone circles or decorative ruins. At most one understated minor trail/shore detail where the panel brief allows it.

jobs.prompt: Refine the SINGLE supplied map crop into a sharply detailed square fantasy-JRPG map painting. This image is an enlarged section of a larger map: preserve its exact framing, camera, footprint scale and cut-off features. Improve roof construction, tiny windows, walls, foliage and water detail inside existing shapes. Keep the original saturated blue/green/gold colors and sunlit atmosphere. Do not pull the camera back or try to show a complete city. No text, grid, frame or watermark. Keep mountains and forest sparse, country buildings tiny and country tracks unpaved. NORTHWEST CROP: the city center fountain is near the extreme lower-right, about 87% across and 87% down. Most of the city continues beyond the RIGHT and BOTTOM image edges; retain those cropped streets and wall. The Evertree stands toward the right edge; do not move it toward the middle. Preserve the sky, mountain horizon, western green ridges, tiny Greywatch ruin and small hot spring exactly where shown. Refine the red academy and northern pale-stone/slate-roof civic blocks without moving them. Do not draw a complete city wall inside this crop.
